P7-A1.title: Golden boards H2, H3, H4 and the golden foldings; T11 golden tab; M7 beat 8
spec: 4 T11 (golden foldings with values a + b phi)
P7-A1.summary: ZPhi {a, b} with the multiplication (ac+bd) + (ad+bc+bd) phi and the exact sign rule; the Arith instance; coxeterH(n); goldenFold(name, v); both games on H2, H3, H4 with the facts of 2.17 (10, 30, 120 roots; orders 10, 120, 14400; games of 5, 15, 60 moves); the T11 golden tab; M7 beat 8 released.

P7-A2.title: Representations with one zero weight: engine, T12 preset, M8 beat 7
P7-A2.summary: orbitPlusZeroMatrices for the vector representations of B_n, the 7 of G2, the adjoint of A1 with coefficient 2 on the two steps that leave the zero position; the T12 preset; M8 beat 7 released.

P7-A3.title: Generalized Satake diagrams as an advanced toggle in T13
oracle: shadow2 on G2 with one black node
P7-A3.summary: Condition 3 replaced by the RV20 condition behind a toggle; the G2 examples whose shadows are not a root system; type recognition refuses them as 2.15 requires.

P7-A4.title: Vogan diagrams beside Satake diagrams (T13 sidebar)
P7-A4.summary: A side-by-side view; no engine computation beyond what exists is specified, so the content is the standard picture with the statement that the same undecorated diagram means the split form as a Satake diagram and the compact form as a Vogan diagram [S2]; anything further is [U] and wrapped.

P7-A5.title: Embeddable web components
spec: 7.4 (Embedding; web components as a phase 7 option)
P7-A5.summary: Custom elements wrapping the tools for embedding without an iframe, with the same state and link format.
